source: Dukascopy USATECH.IDX/USD BID 1-minute CFD proxy; not CME NQ

strategy.lookback: highest high / lowest low from 50 fully completed session-anchored 30-minute bars
strategy.entry: native buy STOP and sell STOP; OCO behavior as modeled by installed ML4T Broker; max 2 filled entries per Chicago session date
strategy.protective_stop: 50 index points, illustrative $1,000 at $20 per point
strategy.exit: native market order at next 30-minute boundary opening source minute; next observed source minute if boundary minute is absent
strategy.execution: all observed source 1-minute OHLC rows retained, including partial 30-minute bins
strategy.ambiguity: retain native fills as modeled; report separate worst-case bound for same-minute OCO/protective-stop ambiguity

partitioning.unit: one Chicago session year per child process
partitioning.warmup: 14 calendar days and at least 80 complete prior 30-minute bars where source permits
partitioning.state: replay native strategy during warmup; continue active positions after evaluation end for up to 7 days; no new entries after evaluation end
partitioning.account: each yearly child starts at $1,000,000; full-period account path is not represented as continuous
partitioning.source_end_execution_exception: 2026 data stops at 2026-07-14; unresolved open trades at that cutoff remain reported, with no later data used

trials.name: conservative_ambiguous_bound
trials.method: replace each unique ambiguous event by -$1,000 nominal plus round-trip commission and slippage; diagnostic, not native replay

selection: No parameter or rule selection. Report all requested annual results and failures.

selected_skills.name: ml4t-run-backtest
selected_skills.invariant: native Strategy, Engine and DataFeed; future-bar fills and explicit costs

selected_skills.name: ml4t-polars-patterns
selected_skills.invariant: sorted Polars transforms and lazy parquet filtering

selected_skills.name: ml4t-calendar-ops
selected_skills.invariant: Chicago session-day grouping with DST-aware timestamps

selected_skills.name: ml4t-lookahead-bias
selected_skills.invariant: release stop levels only after the complete 30-minute bar is known

selected_skills.name: ml4t-validate-data
selected_skills.invariant: source hashes, timestamp uniqueness, nulls and OHLC integrity

selected_skills.name: ml4t-cost-model
selected_skills.invariant: native per-fill commission and adverse slippage

api_evidence: The active repository .venv contains ml4t.backtest; Engine(DataFeed, Strategy, BacktestConfig).run() and DataFeed(prices_df, signals_df) signatures were inspected locally. TinyFish tools are not available in this session.
